newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - FRANCE - LE MONDE MARCH 13.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - FRANCE - LE MONDE MARCH 13.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- Legal authorities intensify fight against paedophile rings in France.
-- Aerospatiale is becoming a major focus in the competition among potential bidders for Thomson-CSF.
-- Restructuring plan at Alcatel-CIT including some 1,400 job cuts in France to be presented at a special board meeting on April 2.
-- Member of parliament's finance committee sees total cost of state rescue of Credit Lyonnais at around 130 billion francs.
-- Societe Generale does not rule out an alliance with an investment bank such as Paribas, according to chairman Marc Vienot.
-- CNPF employers's federation internal report calls for a reshuffle of its organisation, including a direct subscription for companies, bypassing sector federations.
